input_contract: uint8 BGR image; preserve original frame coordinate system
score_convention: Ultralytics detector confidence; not a calibrated image-level PASS probability
counting_contract: Count retained objects for IDs 0 through 5; ID 0 is not an empty-background label; expected counts are supplied externally
decision_owner: P08 shared decision/rejudge implementation; P06 does not duplicate final PASS/FAIL rules
rejection_scope: Only learned non_catalogue detection; complete open-set rejection not validated

initialization.source: Official Ultralytics COCO-pretrained YOLO11n; same initialization SHA as historical P06 trainer
